info.name: Get historical data for an address

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bsc'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: address
params.description: The blockchain address to query historical data for.

items.docs: Returns a daily USD value time series for the specified address.

info.name: Get historical data for an entity

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,bitcoin'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: entity
params.description: The entity ID to query historical data for.

items.docs: Returns a daily USD value time series for the specified entity.
